conversation.message: How have you been feeling lately, overall?
Honestly? I’ve been really down. I used to love coming home to my apartment, but now it just feels empty. I don't know how to make it feel... right again.
What do you think would help your apartment feel less empty?
I don't know. I've tried cleaning, decorating... nothing sticks. I just end up sitting on the couch and staring at the walls. It’s like I’m just going through the motions.
Is it harder to focus or concentrate than it used to be?
Yeah. I read a page in a book and I forget what I read. It's like my mind is just... wandering. I get frustrated because I can't even finish a sentence.
How long has it been since you could read a page without your mind wandering like that?
I don't know... a year? Maybe two? It used to be my favorite thing to do, but now I just can't.
How have you been sleeping lately?
Bad. I wake up in the middle of the night and just lie there. I can't turn my brain off. It's like I’m stuck in this... this limbo.
How long does that feeling of being stuck in limbo usually last when you wake up?
Until I have to get up for work. Then I just get out of bed and go through the motions. I’m just waiting for the day to end.
Been doing anything you enjoy lately?
No. I used to love hiking, but now it just feels like too much effort. I don't have the energy to do anything I used to like.
How long has it felt like too much effort to go hiking?
A few months? Maybe a year? It used to be my favorite thing to do on the weekends, but now it just feels... pointless.
When you think about the next few weeks, what do you expect day to day?
More of the same. Waking up, going to work, coming home... just going through the motions. I don't see any light at the end of the tunnel.
What makes it feel like there's no light at the end of the tunnel?
I don't know. I just... I used to have dreams and goals. Now I don't have any. I’m just stuck.
Do you find it harder to make decisions than before, even small ones?
Yeah. I get paralyzed. I'll stand in the kitchen and stare at the fridge for 20 minutes deciding what to eat. It’s ridiculous.
How often does that feeling of being paralyzed happen when you're trying to decide something?
All the time. It’s like... I used to be so confident, and now I’m just... lost.
Do you feel like you have enough energy for your usual day?
No. I get tired just walking from the car to the office. I feel like I'm running on empty all the time.
How long has it felt like you're running on empty?
Months? A year? I don't know. It just feels like... I’m just going through the motions.
Are you still into the things you used to care about?
No. I don't have the energy to care. I used to love music, but now I just listen to the same songs over and over.
What's it like when you try to listen to something new?
I get bored after a minute. I used to love discovering new bands, but now... nothing excites me.
Is there anything weighing on your mind that you wish you could change?
Yeah. I wish I could just... erase the last few years. I feel like I've made so many mistakes.
What's one mistake that feels especially heavy right now?
I... I let someone go. Someone I loved. I was too scared to make it work, and now I'm alone.
How do you feel about how things have gone for you recently?
I feel like I've failed. I used to think I was doing okay, but... I'm not. I'm just... I’m just stuck.
What does being "stuck" look like for you right now?
It looks like a life that’s just... flat. No excitement, no passion, no sense of purpose. I just feel like I’m just... existing.
How's your appetite been?
It's... off. I eat because I have to, but I don't really taste anything. It’s like I’m just going through the motions.
Has this lack of taste made you avoid certain foods you usually enjoy?
Yeah. I used to love cooking, but now I just... I don't even care. It’s all just the same.
Have you found yourself getting emotional more easily lately?
Yes. I cry a lot. I don't know why. I just... I feel like I'm drowning, and I don't know how to swim.
